rules.create_when: top-level diagram scope requires AWS cloud container
account grouping is selected or multiple accounts are scanned
resource region grouping is enabled and region has discovered resources
subnet classification is verified as public
subnet classification is verified as private or isolated
detailed network view explicitly requests SG visualization
ASG discovered and detailed view enabled

rendering: Boundaries must be dynamically sized containers. Group SVGs are visual references/icons, not fixed-size containers.
